title: 5. WHERE with OR
prompt:
OR keeps a row when either condition is true.

Return name, year_group, and maths_score for students who are in year 13 or have a maths score of at least 90.

(Order does not matter.)
starterQuery:
SELECT name, year_group, maths_score
FROM students
WHERE
solutionQuery: SELECT name, year_group, maths_score FROM students WHERE year_group = 13 OR maths_score >= 90;
